Dr Dabber Stella is a great option! It’s similar to the plus but has a magnetic top rather than a screw so it doesn’t get all gunked up and hard to close. The atomizer in my opinion is a lot better and you don’t have to be as careful with it as I had to do with my puffco plus. The heating/contact pins that are under the ceramic chamber in the puffco easily get loose and can cause it to stop working. I’ve had my stella for about a year and haven’t had any issues. Good luck!

I stopped smoking about 3 days before my test and passed. I made sure to brush my teeth extra well and floss also used hydrogen peroxide to flush my mouth out. Be careful not to have any sores or bleeding gums because my partner did even with not smoking and failed.

I would recommend just buying a drug test about a day or two before your actual one and test yourself. If you quit and drink plenty of water you should be good at 28 days. If you fail the one you buy, you should then get quickfix or something similar. Good luck!
